דְּחַק Ch. Arctare, premere, urgere, festinare: Deinde Syr. & Ch. Repellere, depellere, abjicere, removere. Ithpeh. אִרְתַּחַק Arctari, premi, opprimi.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms were read from a small, faint scan. Syriac words and several Hebrew vowel-pointed forms are uncertain and are marked illegible where I could not read them letter by letter. The catchword is taken as printed at the lower right.
